dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: #Hi there, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Seeing you so full of life puts my mind at rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I love it here!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The scenery here is so different from Mondstadt's. I find it really refreshing.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: And, here I can sing at the top of my voice without having to worry if I'm disturbing anyone! It's the best way to practice.

choices.text: Surely no one would ever consider your sweet voice a disturbance?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It sure is nice of you to say that! But, uh... still, I always need to make sure I'm being considerate of other people.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Anyway, I'm really happy you invited me here!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I think I'd like to stay here a little longer.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Yeah... I'm just so happy that you invited me to come here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, sure!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hehe...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh, I just realized that I haven't chatted with a friend like this in a long time.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I just feel so blessed all of a sudden.

choices.text: Seems like you're easy to please.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Uhh... Is that so...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Well, maybe... but it's not such a bad thing.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: The easier you find it to receive joy, the more energy you have to share that joy with other people.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Ahh... please, no need to shower me with compliments...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Only with constructive criticism can we grow, right...?

choices.text: It's because you're always putting other people first.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Of course I do, that's what I'm supposed to do!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I've always had so many people looking out for me. I just want to do all that is within my power to repay their kindness.

choices.text: You are every bit as wonderful as people say.
Have you suddenly remembered something amusing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I've been practicing a new song recently.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But I'm still trying to iron out a few details...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: When I repeat the chorus, should I go up a half step? I can't decide... And I think there's room for improvement with the dance routine, but I'm not sure...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: If it's no trouble, I'd really appreciate it if you could watch my performance and give me your suggestions.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Thank you...!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Um... Please don't laugh at me if there are parts that still need practicing.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I've thought about this a lot of times in the past, but it's taken me this long to finally pluck up the courage to perform for you at such close distance.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: If you laughed at me, there'd be nowhere I could run from my embarrassment...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Whew... Okay.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Then...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Let the show begin!

choices.text: I believe in you, and you should believe in yourself as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Barbara.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Morning! May you be blessed with a wonderful day!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I'll pray for you~

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Barbara.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Good night! Sweet dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Such a tidy room... It reminds me of the Knights of Favonius' guest room.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Now, if only it had a few cute decorations, it would be even more cozy...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Let's go buy some when you have the time!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The wind blowing through this park brings with it a familiar scent.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: This would be the perfect spot to rest on a nice afternoon, listening to the sounds of the water... It's just so relaxing.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Thank you! I love this place.
